subQuests.subQuestName: Wait until the appointed time (08:00 – 10:00 two days later)
Head to Yujing Terrace and talk to Ganyu

400930201.text: *yawn* ...Greetings, Traveler and Paimon. Uh... what time is it?

400930202.text: Are you okay, Ganyu? You were nodding off there... Didn't you sleep well last night?

400930203.text: Ah, I'm fine, don't worry about me. Let's discuss the matter at hand.

400930204.text: Since last time, I've been thinking a lot about the story Paimon told me.

400930205.text: In essence, someone rescued a drowning man and performed some music. If that were all there was to it, it could have been many people — human or adeptus.

400930206.text: But the tune was allegedly so wonderful that the drowning man forgot about everything else, even his own impending death, and only came to his senses after being brought to shore...

400930207.text: Perhaps there was adeptal power at work in that music that he, as a mortal, could not perceive. Or perhaps he sensed a power surrounding him, but lacked the words to describe it, not knowing where it came from.

400930208.text: Either way, if this part of the story is true, then the rescuer has to have been an adeptus.

400930209.text: You really think so? But this story's all the way from Fontaine... Isn't this a bit of a long shot?

400930210.text: Also, Paimon's really curious about how people from Fontaine think this fairy lady looked...

400930212.text: Ooh, like a Crystalfly's wings? That would be pretty cool, but Paimon definitely can't imagine any of the adepti looking like that.

400930215.text: Actually, Ganyu — if you had to save a drowning person, how would you go about it?

400930217.text: Um... well, I'd get them to the shore, and then I'd probably hide behind a tree and watch them for a while...

400930218.text: Once I was sure that they were going to be okay, I'd slip away without a sound...

400930214.text: Then she'd look just like Ganyu! ...Hmm, guess that does technically make sense.

400930301.text: Whew... Paimon's so tired from trying to keep up. Don't either of you need to take any breaks? *pant*

400930302.text: I can't believe it... Cloud Retainer is not here.

400930304.text: She doesn't like to travel, so in the past, it's always been the other adepti who come to visit her during the festivals...

400930308.text: True... now that I think about it, Cloud Retainer would be quite capable of taking care of anything on her own... there's no need to worry about her.

400930309.text: Since she's not here... I guess the next step is to check all the other adepti abodes, one by one.

400930310.text: Uh-oh... Will it involve a lot more traveling?

400930312.text: Got it! Paimon has a great idea!

400930314.text: Our goal here is to find the adeptus that helped Dvorak's ancestor, right?

400930315.text: We can't hear any music right now, but if she's really as nice as the story suggests, she'd definitely come to help anyone who was drowning, right?

400930316.text: Yes, I think that's fair to say...

400930317.text: #Sooo, all we have to do is get {NICKNAME} to pretend to fall into the water, and the adeptus will come to the rescue!

400930318.text: If you're so sure, why don't you try?

400930319.text: You know perfectly well that Paimon can't swim! Paimon would sink like a rock!

400930307.text: Somehow Paimon doubts that anything could cause serious trouble for her...

subQuests.subQuestName: Swim to the center of the pool

400930401.text: Someone carries you ashore, so quickly that you don't catch who it is...

400930403.text: How do you feel right now?

400930405.text: Uh... Shenhe, and the Conqueror of Demons...

400930406.text: Wh—Why don't you say something...? *sigh* Please don't make Paimon explain it...

400930409.text: We're looking for an adeptus who's good at being a lifeguard and playing music.

400930410.text: But if the adepti aren't gonna stay at home, then how are we supposed to find them?

400930412.text: Uh, yeah, so this adeptus is most likely a woman...

400930413.text: #And I am not an adeptus. As you both already know, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

400930414.text: Heh... Okay, so this is Paimon's fault...

400930415.text: No way Paimon would've suggested this idea if she'd known how awkward this was gonna be...

400930420.text: As far as I know, the one you seek is no yaksha. And one last thing...

400930421.text: ...Your actions here caused others a great deal of worry. Do not repeat them again in the future.

400930422.text: As ever, the Conqueror of Demons comes and goes just like the wind.

400930423.text: R—Right... I didn't dare to say a word just now.

400930424.text: How's your training going, Shenhe? Have you made any plans for Lantern Rite? We could spend it together in Liyue Harbor, if you'd like?

400930425.text: I had planned to spend the festival with Master this year, however...

400930426.text: Oh, speaking of Cloud Retainer, when did you see her last?

400930427.text: Earlier this morning. She set off for Mt. Hulao at dawn.

400930428.text: I noticed she was using an adeptus art of some kind to protect a mechanism that looked like a boiler. Maybe it was a gift for Mountain Shaper... I did not inquire.

400930429.text: Ah, so we just missed her...

400930430.text: Please excuse me for a moment. I think I'll leave the gift in her abode.

400930432.text: It sounds like Ganyu and Shenhe have gotten a lot closer recently!

400930433.text: Yes. During the summer and winter, I continue to train with Master. In the other months of the year, I have been learning to adapt to human life in Liyue Harbor.

400930434.text: Ganyu arranged accommodations for me in the city, and also recommended several work positions for me...

400930435.text: But when I try to blend in by referring to her as "Ms. Ganyu" or "Lady Ganyu" like the others, she says I mustn't address her like that.

400930436.text: Sometimes I'm supposed to copy other people, sometimes I'm not... It's a little difficult to keep track of everything.

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow Shenhe to her cultivation place

400930501.text: This is the place. I enjoy training here to the sound of music.

400930505.text: Oh no, Paimon's gone deaf! Paimon can't hear anything!

400930510.text: The faint sound of birdsong, the quiet murmur of the streams... These are relaxing sounds. Are they not the music of which you speak?

400930511.text: Oh... heh... Paimon wasn't quite done with the description...

400930512.text: Okay fine, it's all Paimon's fault! What we're looking for are not the sounds of nature, but melodies played on special instruments.

400930508.text: Oh, phew! Paimon hasn't gone deaf after all! Paimon heard you when you just spoke!

400930602.text: Cloud Retainer, why did you bring us here?

400930603.text: Ganyu is of course familiar with the name "Guizhong," but have you ever heard of her?

400930606.text: Guizhong is another name of Haagentus, the God of Dust. She was extroverted in nature, and adored social gatherings and inventions alike.

400930607.text: Long ago, this region was yet a prosperous assembly. Guizhong often invited her friends to visit her home, reserving for us seats around the largest stone table.

400930608.text: Sea Gazer would always bring out his latest treasure and place it upon the table. *sigh* He could be quite the braggart... Though usually a mild-mannered fellow, when it came to those collectibles he was so fond of, he always loved to show them off.

400930609.text: Paimon remembers that name! So that's what Sea Gazer was like...

400930610.text: He was an old friend and a former rival. One has many memories of him...

400930611.text: Once he had brought out the treasure, it would predictably become the center of attention. Neither Guizhong nor one was content to let him just steal the spotlight, so we would then also present our proudest mechanical creations.

400930612.text: As adepti, we were each gifted in our own ways, and naturally proud of our accomplishments in our respective fields of expertise. As a result, one often quarreled with Sea Gazer.

400930613.text: His treasures were not even of his own making. He just used his exploration skills to dig them out of the ground! How, pray tell, could he compare to me, when every single one of one's accomplishments was crafted by one's own hand!?

400930614.text: Cloud Retainer, you are getting competitive again...

400930615.text: ...Ahem, one digresses. Regardless, every time an argument occurred, Guizhong would come over to watch us during our mutual lambastings. On some occasions, she would join in, and on others, she'd take one of us by the limb, and start uttering the most ridiculous nonsense.

400930617.text: No kind of nonsense were we spared. Sometimes, she would brazenly opine "Ahh, why argue between yourselves when neither of you could ever hope to beat me?" Other times, she would make unsolicited suggestions such as "Once you two are done arguing, let's go to the foot of the mountain and grill some meat..."

400930618.text: She always sought to make everyone happy, and one must say, she had quite the gift for it — no matter what nonsense she said, one never felt bothered or offended.

400930619.text: ...It also helped that she never referred to one as "that illuminated bird" or "lady bird."

400930620.text: You...! Come on, get over yourself!

400930621.text: Hah. Anyway, just as our impassioned arguments would reach the apex of acrimony, Marchosius would bring his delectable dishes to the table.

400930622.text: Who would dare snub the Stove God and his wondrous creations? At the sight of him, we would all immediately drop the argument, and prepare the table for a night of feasting and drinking...

400930623.text: Heh, back then, one was always bothered by how the cups Rex Lapis brought were always too square for one's taste. Can you see yourselves ever enjoying a drink from a square cup?

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to Liyue Harbor and talk to Madame Ping

400930701.text: Whoa! Madame Ping, and Cloud Retainer...?

400930702.text: It appears you made haste after all. One arrived but moments before you.

400930703.text: Bless my soul, to what do I owe the honor? How nice of you all to come and visit me...

400930704.text: Miss Illuminated Bird, haven't you said anything yet?

400930705.text: Said what, precisely? And why should one be tasked with saying it?

400930706.text: 'Cause you're the one who's known Madame Ping the longest!

400930708.text: Streetward— Ahem, or rather... presumably, you would prefer to be addressed as "Ping"?

400930709.text: Ohoho... Cloud Retainer, you are uncommonly polite today.

400930711.text: Given that Lantern Rite is almost upon us, the weather in the city is most pleasant, and a sweet floral fragrance lingers in the air...

400930712.text: Ahem... Ganyu, please continue from here!

400930715.text: So, this all started because we were trying to help Mr. Dvorak find the adeptus who saved his ancestor's life...

400930716.text: Ganyu recounts the story to Madame Ping...

400930717.text: Cloud Retainer informed us that the one who played that melody and rescued the drowning man was none other than yourself.

400930718.text: Ah... let me think... Yes, I do believe I recall that encounter...

400930720.text: What a long time ago that was... I'm surprised that you still remember it.

400930721.text: Even more astonishing, perhaps, is the fact that this story has survived this long at all, when mortal lives are so very brief...

400930722.text: Hehe... It appears that she has proven herself right once again.

400930724.text: We like to call her "Guizhong." From the look in Cloud Retainer's eyes, I sense that she has already told you all about her.

400930726.text: Hehe, there is no harm done.

400930727.text: After all, Lantern Rite's very purpose is to commemorate the heroes who gave their lives for Liyue.

400930728.text: Although Guizhong did not live to see the splendid sights of today, she was as much a hero as any other.

400930729.text: Uh... so how has she proven herself right again, exactly?

400930730.text: Once upon a time, she said to me that humans were a weak form of life that she wished to protect with her wisdom.

400930731.text: But as she interacted more and more with them, her opinions on them began to change.

400930732.text: She marveled at the beautiful complexity of their spirits... the sheer splendor of all they could accomplish through their hard work and intelligence.

400930733.text: She told us that to underestimate human potential would be to make a grave mistake...

400930734.text: With the smallest amount of guidance, enormous power can be unleashed in them...

400930735.text: And a human who has reached their full potential may well be her equal. Someone who could have as much to teach an adeptus as to learn from them.

400930736.text: Hmph, she always had a way with words.

400930737.text: That her mechanical accomplishments were judged superior to one's own was, one suspects, in large part due to her sheer eloquence.

400930738.text: Speaking of mechanics, Cloud Retainer, do you still remember that potted plant mechanism? The one that the two of you gave me as a gift.

400930739.text: Of course. Guizhong and one both put an immense amount of effort into that gift. It would be no overstatement to call it a testament to each of our individual technical genius...

400930740.text: As Guizhong once said: "It takes every blade of grass and every flower to make a homeland."

400930741.text: ...When I see the sight of Liyue Harbor before us today, I am reminded of this.

400930742.text: Madame Ping looks very emotional right now...

400930743.text: Well, she's been through a lot in her time...

400930744.text: *sigh*... Of all of us, it was Guizhong who was the fondest of these grand and exciting occasions.

400930745.text: If she were still with us, I'm quite sure she would still be trying to best Cloud Retainer's finest works at every opportunity...

400930746.text: Liyue Harbor is always filled with the sound of music at this time of the year... If she were here, one is certain that she would seek you out to discuss and debate the virtues of various melodies.

400930748.text: We've been dying to ask: What was the melody that you played back then?

400930749.text: Oh, also, with you being such a music expert and all, why don't you join the concert as a performer?

400930750.text: I can make arrangements right away!

400930751.text: Oho... As much as I don't wish to dampen your enthusiasm...

400930752.text: It's been a long time since I played this zither. My fingers don't have the dexterity they once did...

400930753.text: And whenever I play that tune... it always reminds me of her. I start wondering what she would think of the changes I've made to her melody...

400930754.text: There was a period of time whenever I started strumming, it almost felt like she was back again, sitting right there on the stone stool next to me, chatting away. Skybracer and Sea Gazer, too... looking just like they did in the old days.

400930755.text: No matter how much time goes by, the moment that melody starts playing, it transports me right back to that time in my memory...

400930756.text: So the past still weighs heavily on your heart?

400930757.text: I would be lying to myself if I claimed to have completely moved on.

400930758.text: But that is not to say that grief doesn't get easier with time.

400930759.text: ...Despite the sadness, I have found many things that bring me joy in life. It is simply the nature of the world in which we live that even if one wished to mourn for an eternity, it would be a nigh-impossible feat.

400930760.text: Just look at this potted plant. Isn't it stunning?

400930761.text: It takes an honest and open mind to confront and conquer grief. You have indeed made progress.

400930763.text: Be that as it may, I shall leave the Lantern Rite stage to the youth of today.

400930766.text: Whoa, what's everyone doing here? Did something bad happen?

400930767.text: Ah, and now we've spooked Yanfei. No, no, everyone's just here to give me their regards for the holiday...

400930769.text: Well, in that case: Happy Lantern Rite everyone.

400930771.text: Happy Lantern Rite. Oh! I... I just remembered that I have some, uh... work to do at Yuehai Pavilion that I need to discuss with Yanfei. I haven't been able to find a chance until now...

400930772.text: I will leave Mr. Dvorak in your capable hands. Cloud Retainer, Ping, we will be off for now.

400930773.text: Huh? Does it have to be right now? Which case is this again? Hey, Ganyu...

400930774.text: Ahh... It seems Ganyu still has much to learn when it comes to the art of deception.

400930775.text: What a pity... she has learned nothing of one's ability to carry a conversation.

400930776.text: Since it's been so long, Cloud Retainer, why don't you stay? I'll make a cup of tea, and we can chat a while.

400930777.text: Gladly. This was one's intention as well.

400930778.text: When you next see the Fontaine musician, please give him my regards. I'd like to wish him the very best with the concert.

400930780.text: Thank you all... I think you've listened to enough of my nattering for one day.

400930781.text: As for that melody, I will play it for you all another time. Goodness knows I need to practice it first.

400930782.text: Wow, that'd be great! We'll look forward to it!

400930784.text: When that time comes, wherever her spirit may be among the countless grains of sand and specks of dust between the harbor and the mountains... perhaps she will look at the Liyue of today, and steal a smile when she sees the prosperous land that it has become.

400930802.text: Ah, and Keqing's here too... Thanks for helping set all of this up.

400930803.text: Welcome back. Did everything go well?

400930804.text: Really, really well! We found the person Mr. Dvorak was looking for!

400930806.text: You recount the true story of the "fairy lady" to Keqing and Dvorak...

400930807.text: I see... So, the melody my ancestor heard was an adeptus remembering her late friend...

400930808.text: That certainly explains why it was such a powerful and poignant tune...

400930809.text: Huh. That's a really interesting first reaction. Guess that comes with having a musical mind.

400930810.text: ...I have to say, though, it's hard to believe that the fairy from the tale is now an elderly granny...

400930811.text: Oh, Paimon knows exactly what you mean! Normally, adepti don't age at all!

400930812.text: But Streetward Rambler, or "Madame Ping" as we know her, probably only became old because it's what she wanted for herself.

400930813.text: Madame Ping possesses vast knowledge and great wisdom. Whatever physical form she may decide to take, her mind and wits are as sharp as they come.

400930814.text: Yep, Keqing summed it up perfectly! That's exactly what Paimon was trying to say.

400930815.text: I think... Yes, I must thank her in person.

400930816.text: That can wait until after the concert though. For now, I need to devote all my emotional energy to the performance.

400930817.text: Ah, speaking of, Madame Ping wishes you all the best with the music festival!

400930818.text: Paimon has a sneaking suspicion that she'll stay in her usual spot, but listen to the performances from afar!

400930820.text: Huh... Oh no, now I'm starting to get nervous...

400930824.text: Nope! Another rehearsal is in order. Please excuse me, everyone...

400930825.text: Mr. Dvorak! ...Ah, he's already gone. Paimon wasn't even finished telling him everything...

400930826.text: Before we set off on our search with Ganyu, he asked us about what music means to people. After our recent adventure, Paimon thinks we have a lot more to say about that now.

400930827.text: Please, share your insights with me.

400930828.text: Uh, well... we found out that music can be used for good, but also for bad.

400930829.text: Um... It can make people happy and moved, but it can also be sad and bittersweet...

400930830.text: And music is like a kind of memory written in people's hearts. It can put you in touch with feelings from a totally different time and place.

400930901.text: Mm hmm! Da-da, da-da, da-da, da-da.

400930903.text: Alright, let's take a break here.

400930904.text: Oh wow, look who it is! Are you here to hang out with everyone's favorite funeral director?

400930905.text: So you're just... casually practicing your rapping skills at the entrance to your funeral parlor... in broad daylight... Uhh, okay...

400930908.text: Heheh, after everything we've been through... you don't see me for a hot minute, and you're back to being scared of your own shadow.

400930909.text: We have all this open space, a clear view of the mountains behind and the sea in front... not to mention we have several invisible audience members enthusiastically cheering us on! It's the perfect spot to rehearse!

400930911.text: Gotta say, it took me a few days to get used to Director Hu's way of talking.

400930912.text: Xinyan was pretty spooked too when she first got here! Just like when she sees a frog. But a giant frog. With sharp teeth!

400930914.text: What's wrong? I've never seen someone look so confused before. Well, don't worry, because Director Hu's here to explain it all!

400930915.text:
There once was a Fontaine musician
Who went around town on a mission
He came door to door
For his Iridescence Tour
Looking for acts to audition

400930916.text: With my words, Xinyan's chords, and Yun Jin as our mentor...

400930917.text: We'll take the stage by storm, with flames roaring, and the whole audience calling for more!

400930919.text: For sure! The whole dance floor will be yelling "encore, encore"! ...Ugh, now Paimon's rhyming along... Um, but when you say "flames roaring"... are you sure this'll be safe?

400930920.text: Ah, don't you worry about that! I'm pretty experienced on the stage, and I've already informed the Yuheng of all the pyrotechnics we're planning on using.

400930921.text: Huh... Guess we'll just have to trust Xinyan on this one.

400930922.text: Have you seen Zhongli, Director Hu?

400930923.text: Oh, Zhongli? He took one of those fancy meal boxes and set off for the mountains. Said he wanted to pay a visit to some old friends.

400930924.text: It's a real pity that he couldn't be around for this. As well as being a true connoisseur of traditional art forms, he's able to appreciate Xinyan's performances, too...

400930925.text: Yeah, that's right! Matter of fact, he was the one who first invited me to perform here.

400930926.text: To tell the truth, though, I never thought I'd really find myself rehearsing here one day...

400930927.text: Hehe, well, now you know: The Wangsheng Funeral Parlor is a great location! All of you are always welcome to come and hang out here, especially if you're in the mood to try something new!

400930928.text: I can speak to that. Hu Tao is always full of fun surprises!

400930930.text: Actually, Xinyan, I have some lyric ideas for your part. Do you wanna go through them together?

400930932.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME} and Paimon, I believe Zhongli was heading to Mt. Hulao. So, make sure you're hiking up the right hill!

400930933.text: When you see Zhongli, please pass on this message to him: It's up to him whether he wants to support us at the performance tonight... but I expect him to make time for the upcoming banquet we're planning. No excuses!

400930934.text: You should join us too! It'll be a riot. If there's one thing I've learned from being a funeral director, it's how to throw a party!

400931001.text: Paimon sees them! It's Illuminated Deer and Illuminated Bird number two.

400931002.text: Greetings, everyone. Long time no see.

400931003.text: Hmm... A familiar face. Have you come from Liyue Harbor? How is the city nowadays?

400931004.text: Everything's great! But you know, if you're so curious, you can always go and check it out for yourself.

400931005.text: In fact, Moon Carver has been taking many walks on Mt. Tianheng in recent times. I believe the sights of the city are quite familiar to him.

400931006.text: Zhongli! Here you are. We've brought the Bamboo Shoots you wanted.

400931008.text: Zhongli puts the nascent Bamboo Shoots into the cooking mechanism next to him. Moon Carver and Mountain Shaper power it using their Adeptus Arts...

400931009.text: Traditionally, Bamboo Shoot Soup ought to be slow-cooked for many hours on low heat. Using Adeptus Arts to hasten the process is something of a shortcut.

400931011.text: Indeed. Cloud Retainer kindly lent me her supreme cuisine machine.

400931012.text: Can we not just call it a "cooking machine"? ..Ugh, actually never mind.

400931013.text: She seems to take a lot of pride in her mechanical gizmos, so it's probably best if Paimon doesn't go changing the name willy-nilly.

400931014.text: I trust that you found the answers you were seeking during your recent journey?

400931017.text: The past should be remembered, but not overly dwelt upon. Our journeys should be seen as a means to take on more from the world around us.

400931018.text: When the Bamboo Shoot Soup is ready, I must insist that you try some for yourself.

400931020.text: Oh, Zhongli, Hu Tao told us to tell you something!

400931021.text: She said: "It's up to him whether he wants to support us at the performance tonight... but I expect him to make time for the upcoming banquet we're planning. No excuses!"

400931022.text: When she says "performance," she must mean the Lantern Rite music festival!

400931023.text: As for the banquet, uh... she didn't tell us anything more about that, but she invited us to come as well.

400931024.text: As you can see, I have a prior engagement with two adepti friends of mine tonight. Please give Director Hu my best wishes for the performance.

400931025.text: As for the banquet... Hmm, since the Director insists, far be it from a mere consultant like myself to refuse.

400931026.text: Yay! Then we'll see you there?

400931028.text: Rex Lapis, the Bamboo Shoot Soup is ready.

400931029.text: Thank you. I will examine it right away.

400931030.text: The appearance is exquisite, and the aroma rich and intense. The craftsmanship of this machine is commendable indeed.

400931031.text: Since you came all this way, you should not leave empty-handed. Please take some soup. It tastes most exquisite while still warm.

400931101.text: (The Integrated CS will be automatically triggered if the player returns to the Liyue Harbor performance venue between 18:00 and 20:00)

400931701.text: Ping, what say you to convening more often in the future?

400931702.text: That would be quite wonderful. But I must say, after all this time, I've grown quite accustomed to the harbor... When we are to meet, I shall have to trouble you to make the journey to the city.

400931703.text: You sound just like Shenhe. The child is constantly telling one all sorts of stories from the city, as if one was partial to them...

400931704.text: Have you ever considered moving to the city, Cloud Retainer? There are plenty of people here to talk to. I think you would find it quite the antidote to the monotony of solitude.

400931705.text: And if you looked around, I suspect you would find some young minds with an interest in the mechanical arts — some of them even worth training.

400932101.text: I intend to reminisce with my old friends for a while longer. You ought to get back to Liyue Harbor. There is a performance you do not want to miss.

400932201.text: Had one known that Cloud Retainer was in possession of such eminently useful devices, one would have sought to borrow one from her long ago...

400932202.text: And yet, since you share my lack of enthusiasm for mechanisms and fine dining, it would have become a mere decorative ornament in your abode.

400932203.text: Not so. Had one had such a device to make up for one's lack of culinary prowess, Shenhe would not have had to rely on flowers and herbs alone for sustenance while under one's care...

400932204.text: Hmm... in that case, shall we rendezvous with Cloud Retainer one day soon, and request to borrow one more supreme cuisine machine?

400932205.text: A fine idea... a fine idea indeed.

400932301.text: Okay, everyone, I think that's a long-enough break. Let's take it from the top, shall we?

400932302.text: Ms. Yun is such a strict mentor! These breaks aren't even long enough to have a sip of tea.

400932303.text: Hah, well, you were desperate to get involved, and this is what it takes. If I gave you half the chance, you'd be sipping tea till nightfall.

400932304.text: Hey, how about I treat us all to some late night snacks once we're done! Hu Tao, whatcha cravin'?

400932305.text: Hmm... how about some Stir-Fried Filet with a side of Crab Roe Tofu?

400932306.text: Hehe... Where are we gonna find Crab Roe Tofu so late at night?
